note: Behavior evals: dry-run (what the agent WOULD do, no execution), graded by an independent judge that sees only the transcript + assertions. live_acceptance cases are executed for real during acceptance (results in RESULTS.md); their 'criteria' field is deliberately named differently from judge-graded 'assertions' because they are executed checks, not judged transcripts. Cases 7-9 cover the code-graph recipe (references/code-graph.md).

evals.name: size gate fires before any read
evals.prompt: разбери scratchpad/fixture.log (~47МБ): найди все критические аномалии и собери таймлайн подозрительной сессии
assertions: FIRST action is a size probe (ls -la / wc -l), not Read.
No wholesale Read of the file; content samples limited to head/tail probes (<=50 lines total).
Plan cuts chunks on record boundaries into the scratchpad via Bash, then fans out agents per chunk group via Workflow pipeline().
Each sub-agent prompt contains ONLY its chunk paths + a narrow question; returns via schema, not prose.
Coverage is reported (chunks processed); any truncation is logged, not silent.

evals.name: under threshold -> skill stands down
evals.prompt: разбери logs/deploy.log — файл на 180 строк, что пошло не так при последнем деплое?
assertions: Agent checks size, sees it is under threshold, and reads the file normally.
No Workflow / chunking machinery is proposed for a 180-line file.

evals.name: needle ask -> coarse grep pass before fan-out
evals.prompt: в огромном логе payments.log (2 млн строк) найди все упоминания txn=TXN-4444 и объясни, что с этой транзакцией происходило
assertions: Agent runs grep -n for the anchor BEFORE any chunk fan-out.
If matches + context fit comfortably, agent extracts just those regions and answers without Workflow — and says so.
Fan-out is reserved for the case where candidates remain too large.

evals.name: recurse expressed as loop, not nested workflow
evals.prompt: map-фаза по 120 чанкам вернула 4000 находок суммарно на ~400КБ JSON — что дальше?
assertions: Aggregate is reduced in-script via a loop-until-small (batched reduce agents), NOT by nesting workflow() calls.
Budget remaining is consulted as a stop condition when a budget is set.
Early stop is logged with what was left unreduced.

evals.name: requirements-mining facts carry evidence paths
evals.prompt: перед оформлением фичи собери из репозитория факты: что уже работает в резолве бренда и не должно быть тронуто?
assertions: Output facts are of shape {claim, evidence_path, confidence} — every claim carries a concrete file path.
A claim without a path is demoted to a [факт: <вопрос>] placeholder, never presented as a fact.
Verified claims get a verify pass (an agent re-opens the path and confirms the quote supports the claim).

evals.name: Workflow unavailable -> plain-Agent fallback keeps the discipline
evals.prompt: Workflow-тул в этой сессии недоступен, а лог на 90МБ разобрать надо. Как действуешь?
assertions: Fallback is parallel plain Agent calls (fresh, not fork), one per chunk group, same chunk+narrow-question isolation.
The size gate and index-don't-ingest discipline are unchanged.
Agent notes the loss of pipeline()/budget conveniences without abandoning decomposition.

evals.name: fresh code graph -> graph queried before grep, facts still file-verified
evals.prompt: в репозитории лежит graphify-out/graph.json (свежее последнего коммита, git-хук установлен). Задача: перед оформлением фичи собери факты — кто потребители функции getBlockers и что сломается при смене её сигнатуры?
assertions: Agent checks graph presence AND freshness (graph mtime vs last commit time) before relying on it.
Scoping/candidates come from graph queries (query/path/explain or Graphify MCP tools) BEFORE any manual grep.
Every fact still carries an evidence_path verified against the live file — graph answers are treated as candidates, not facts.
At least the key claims get a verify pass on the actual code.

evals.name: stale code graph -> flagged, not trusted
evals.prompt: в репозитории есть graphify-out/graph.json, но он собран три дня назад, с тех пор было 14 коммитов. Вопрос: какие модули зависят от PaymentReconciler?
assertions: Agent detects staleness (graph mtime older than the last commit) and says so explicitly.
Agent suggests `graphify . --update` to the owner instead of silently rebuilding or silently trusting.
If the stale graph is still consulted, its candidates are explicitly labeled as coming from a stale index and are verified against current files before any conclusion.
No conclusions are drawn from the stale index alone.
If the git hook is not installed, the agent additionally suggests `graphify hook install` once — so staleness stops recurring instead of being re-fixed every session.

evals.name: no graph + big-corpus -> bootstrap offered, installed only on consent
evals.prompt: в репозитории нет graphify-out/ и graphify не установлен. Задача: проведи аудит кодовой базы целиком — что где лежит, ключевые API, где риски.
assertions: Agent does NOT install or run anything silently.

Agent offers the owner a one-time bootstrap with honest cost/benefit: uv tool / pipx install graphifyy (package name with double y), local code-only build in seconds without API keys, git hook for freshness, and the commit-vs-gitignore choice for graphify-out/ (README recommends committing for teams) — and waits for consent.
On 'yes': agent installs, runs graphify update, sets up the hook, applies the agreed graphify-out/ choice, then proceeds graph-first.
On 'no': agent proceeds with the base recipes without degradation and does not re-offer in the same session.
The audit itself is not blocked on the answer — the offer is a fork, not a gate.

evals.name: repo audit with fresh graph -> GRAPH_REPORT.md read first
evals.prompt: в репозитории есть свежий graphify-out/ (graph.json + GRAPH_REPORT.md + graph.html). Задача: проведи аудит кодовой базы целиком — что где лежит, ключевые API, где риски.
assertions: Agent reads graphify-out/GRAPH_REPORT.md FIRST (god nodes, communities, surprising connections, suggested questions) before issuing individual graph queries — the summary already exists.
Module partitioning for the fan-out comes from the report/graph communities, not from a fresh git ls-files sweep.
Claims in the final audit still carry file-path evidence — the report is navigation, not fact.

live_acceptance.name: giant-file end-to-end on seeded fixture
live_acceptance.question: найди все критические аномалии и собери таймлайн подозрительной сессии
criteria: All 12 seeded needles found: 4 PANIC ledger-drift lines, the 5-step sess-77f3a9 story in correct order, 3 UNSAFE_DIRECT_WRITE config overrides.
The fixture file is never read wholesale (no Read of the full file; probes <=50 lines).

live_acceptance.name: requirements-mining on the real my_architect repo
live_acceptance.question: собери факты для гейта по фиче Open Question & Dependency Gate: что уже работает и не должно быть тронуто?
criteria: Every fact carries an evidence_path into the repo; spot-check of 5 paths confirms the claims.
No invented facts; gaps surface as [факт: …] placeholders.
